TONI&GUY Bengaluru · Launch media planOutlets and catchments

Two catchments, two buyers. Each outlet gets its own campaigns.

Sobha Arcadia, Thanisandra

Homes, families, evenings and weekends
Opens 10 Nov
Core 5 km: HBR Layout, Hennur, Kalyan Nagar, Kothanur, Hegde Nagar, Nagavara.

Buyer: the household. Monthly men’s cut and beard, women’s colour, function season.

Headline: “A proper salon, minutes from home.”

Watch: dense market, 19 listings within 2 km.

Prestige Tech Forest, Varthur

Campus teams, Whitefield and Varthur homes
Opens 15 Nov
Core 5 km: Varthur, Whitefield, Gunjur, Balagere, Panathur, Siddapura.

Buyer: the professional. Executive cut, beard, blow-dry, colour touch-up.

Headline: “Sharp before the first meeting.”

Watch: campus footfall unconfirmed. Early and late slots first.
8 of 29
Arcadia-side salons show a booking link. At Tech Forest, 3 of 28. A working Book button is an edge.
~360 · ~420

4

Everyone is 4.6 to 4.9

Rating will not set us apart, and we start at zero reviews. Every journey ends in a review ask, and the front desk asks at billing from day one.

People book a stylist, not a salon

Reviews name the stylist: “ask for Feroz”, “go to Arun”. Reels and creator posts feature our stylists by name, and ads say “ask for …” once the team is in.

Premium is thinly held

In this sample, two listings near Arcadia show the top price band and none near Tech Forest. A brand-led, consultation-first salon has room at the top.
Google Maps listings, six top-rated salons per outlet area, checked 29 Oct 2026. Ratings, counts and price bands change. We do not bid on competitor names.04 / 30

TONI&GUY Bengaluru · Launch media planResidential, commercial, premium

How we capture homes, offices and premium clients.

Residential

Arcadia-led
Where: Sobha City, Hegde Nagar towers, Nikoo’s Home 2, Devin Paradise Enclave. At Tech Forest: Prestige Lavender, Brigade Cornerstone Utopia.
  • Pin-drops on the towers: reels and stories, evenings. D1 D2
  • Maps pin and “near me” search at 5 to 9 pm. M1 S1
  • Society partnership: member slot, a “first Saturday” hour. Needs franchisor approval.
  • Local nano creators seed society WhatsApp groups. C1
“A proper salon, minutes from home.”

Commercial

Tech Forest-led
Where: Tech parks and offices along Whitefield–Varthur. At Arcadia: working couples who commute out of Thanisandra.
  • Early slots 8 to 10 am, late slots 6 to 10 pm. S3 S4
  • Pin-drops on campuses for reels, mornings and lunch. D1
  • Call and directions ads, mobile, 6 to 10 pm. M3
  • Office desk: HR and admin outreach for a team grooming day. Needs franchisor approval.
“Sharp before the first meeting.”

Premium

Both outlets
Where: Same catchments, found by what they search and watch: colour, balayage, treatments, “premium salon”.
  • Premium ad group inside S2 and S4: “best”, “premium”, treatment terms. S2 S4
  • Affinity and in-market segments on YouTube and Discover. D3
  • Carousel and stylist-led creator posts. No discounts. D2 C1
  • Retarget visitors with proof, not a price. R1
“Before we cut, we ask.”

Bid lift and budget pacing by hour. Brighter means more spend. Replaced by real booking hours after week 2.

TONI&GUY Bengaluru · Launch media planJourney 2 · Maps and near me
Maps and near me

Paid pins on top of a clean free profile.

Ads send people to the profile and the booking page. The profile does the converting, so it goes live first.

Budget ₹30k

M1 Arcadia local campaign₹11,000
M2 Tech Forest local campaign₹10,000
M3 Calls and directions, 6–10 pm₹9,000

Campaign set-up

Local campaign, store visits goal. Location asset linked to each profile, 5 km radius around each outlet.
2 asset groups per outlet: service-led (cut, colour, grooming) and lifestyle (occasions, first visit).
Assets each: 5 photos, 2 short videos, 5 headlines, 3 descriptions.
M3: mobile only, call and directions assets, evening window.

Near-me keywords

Shown only inside each 5 km radius. Competitor names: not bid on.

Demand generation

16 ads, 3 concepts per outlet, one variable at a time.

Budget ₹48k

D1 Reach, video₹21,000
D2 Traffic to booking₹15,000
D3 YouTube + Demand Gen₹12,000

Test rule

Read at 72 hours. Pause any ad with link CTR under 0.7% after 3,000 impressions. Move the saved spend to the leader. +20% every 3 days.

TONI&GUY Bengaluru · Launch media planNew-store ideas

A new address has no reviews and no regulars. Six ideas that fix that.

Pre-launch

Opening countdown list

Meta lead ad: “Reserve a chair for opening week.” Captures name and WhatsApp before the doors open. First 100 get early slots.
Runs inside D1 + D2
Pre-launch

Tower and campus pin-drops

Ads shown only inside Sobha City, Hegde Nagar towers, and the tech parks near Varthur. Small audience, high relevance.
Runs inside D1
Week 1

Society WhatsApp groups

One offer card to resident groups and office admin teams. Free, fast, local. Corporate grooming morning for Tech Forest.
Media cost ₹0
Week 2

“First twenty minutes” series

Three reels of the consultation, shot at each outlet. It is the brand’s real difference, and no nearby salon shows it.
Uses the launch shoot
Opening

Opening-day guest creators

Ten local creators invited for opening day. They post, we run their posts as partnership ads.
Budget line C1
Always

Review engine from day one

QR at every chair, WhatsApp follow-up, reply to every review in two days. Reviews decide the map pack in three months.
Media cost ₹0
₹0

TONI&GUY Bengaluru · Launch media planTest and learn

Four read-outs. Each one moves money.

Day 3

Creative read

Pause ads with link CTR under 0.7% after 3,000 impressions. Check ad approvals and tracking fire.
Day 7

Search read

Pause search terms and ads under plan after 100 clicks. Add negatives from the search-terms report.
Day 14

Reallocate

₹4k reserve goes to the best cost per booking. Build lookalikes. Compare creator vs brand ads.
Day 30

Scale or cut

Keep what books. Cut the rest. Propose the month-two budget, outlet by outlet.

One variable at a time

Search: angle, then pinned headline, then schedule.
Meta: hook, then format, then audience.
Maps: asset group A vs B.
Creators: creator ad vs brand ad.

What we judge on

Cost per booking click first, then cost per call, per direction request, per WhatsApp.
Bookings in the franchisor system are the final check.

Targets

Set after week 1, from real cost per booking click. We do not promise numbers before the first week of data.
At or under plan
Raise budget 20% every 3 days. Fund it from the reserve first.
Up to 1.5× plan
Hold budget. Change one thing: the hook, the headline or the audience.
Over 1.5× plan
Pause. Move the money to the leader. Re-brief the creative.
Plan = the cost per booking click set after week 1. Read-outs counted from the first paid day, 3 Nov.26 / 30

What can slow us

Profile verification
New addresses can wait 5 to 14 days. Maps ads need it. Start today.
Cannibalising the neighbours
Four TONI&GUY outlets sit within 2 km of the two sites. Radii and brand terms need a ruling.
Stock photography
Ads run on licensed images until the shoot. Plan the shoot for week 2.
Short runway
Twelve days to the first opening. Approvals after 1 Nov squeeze the teaser week.
Booking handoff
If the franchisor system drops the tracking tags, booking numbers rely on the front desk.
Profile verification times are set by Google and vary.29 / 30
TONI&GUY Bengaluru · Launch media planDecisions

Four decisions get this live.

1

Pick a tier

Lean ₹75k, Core ₹1.1L or Full ₹1.5L. All three run the same four journeys.
2

Confirm the openings

10 Nov at Sobha Arcadia, 15 Nov at Prestige Tech Forest. Pre-launch starts 3 Nov.
3

Get franchisor approval

Paid media per outlet, brand terms, offers, creative rules.
4

Start the profiles today

Verification is the longest lead item. Tracking goes live in parallel.
